title: BEYOND THE HORIZON
subtitle: Exploring the Unknown: From the Deepest Oceans to the Distant Stars
question: FIVE ENVIRONMENTS. ONE QUESTION: IS THE DISCOVERY WORTH THE RISK?
conclusion: Exploration helps us understand our world and discover what lies beyond it. Although it involves risks and costs, responsible exploration creates knowledge and opportunities for future generations.
definition: Scientific exploration asks questions, collects evidence, and shares knowledge. It has a research purpose; tourism and recreation have other goals.
credit: A GRADE 10 ENGLISH EXPLORATION PROJECT / ALBANIA

regions.title: SPACE
regions.advantages: New discoveries, scientific knowledge, and better technology.
regions.disadvantages: Radiation, high costs, and dangerous missions.
regions.solution: Protect crews with tested shielding; use robotic scouts.
regions.note: Protection reduces risk; it cannot remove it.

regions.title: DEEP OCEAN
regions.annotation: BELOW THE SURFACE / LIFE IN THE DARK
regions.advantages: Discover marine life and understand deep ecosystems.
regions.disadvantages: Extreme pressure and damage to fragile habitats.
regions.solution: Use pressure-tested, remotely operated underwater vehicles.
regions.note: ROVs let people study the deep ocean from a ship.

regions.title: ANTARCTICA
regions.annotation: ICE CORES / CLUES TO PAST CLIMATE
regions.advantages: Study past climate, changing ice, and polar environments.
regions.solution: Use specialized equipment and international cooperation.
regions.note: Air bubbles in ice preserve samples of the past atmosphere.
regions.photo_caption: Livingston Island / Anne Dirkse / CC BY-SA 4.0

regions.title: RAINFORESTS
regions.advantages: Discover biodiversity and understand how forests work.
regions.disadvantages: Disease, difficult terrain, and ecological disturbance.
regions.solution: Use remote sensing, small teams, and responsible research.
regions.note: Respect local communities and their knowledge.
regions.photo_caption: Queensland / Robert Kerton, CSIRO / CC BY 3.0

regions.title: MOUNTAINS
regions.advantages: Improve maps and study glaciers and mountain environments.
regions.solution: Plan carefully, use rescue systems, and conserve habitats.
regions.note: A summit is optional. Returning safely matters more.
